one_line: Customizable work-management platform (owned by Citrix) whose entire frontend is built on a fully exposed REST API with webhooks.
auth_notes: OAuth2 authentication; API key obtained per app from account settings. Official client libraries for PHP, .NET, Ruby, Java, Python, Android, and Objective-C.
self_serve_notes: Free basic plan available; API key is self-serve from account settings once you have an account.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Entire Podio frontend is built on the API - items, apps, spaces, tasks, contacts, status, flows, widgets, etc.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks can be registered in Podio apps for event-driven integrations

existing_mcp.note: No official Podio MCP server found; community servers exist

evidence.note: Fetched docs confirmed OAuth2, self-serve API key, client libraries, webhooks, and API breadth

agent_notes: No official MCP; everything else confirmed from fetched docs.
